main_library.notes: Reviewed PyanNet, SincNet, powerset conversion, frame inference, Hamming overlap-add, segmentation activation, and loss semantics. VoiceHub does not import or execute pyannote.audio.

filterbank_reference.notes: Reviewed ParamSincFB initialization and filter equations. VoiceHub implements the equations directly in PyTorch and does not import asteroid-filterbanks.

brouhaha_reference.notes: Reviewed the three-head PyanNet graph, bounded VAD/SNR/C50 activations, six-second repeated-final-chunk inference, speech-masked SNR objective, and training recipe.

checkpoints.notes: This gated Hugging Face file was not available to the verifier account. Its digest is intentionally not guessed; conversion still requires an explicit trust acknowledgement and a complete name-and-shape match.

security_boundary.conversion: Official checkpoints are converted once with torch.load(weights_only=True), an inert compatibility allowlist, an explicit trust_pickle_checkpoint=True acknowledgement, optional SHA-256 verification, and strict complete tensor inventory validation.
security_boundary.runtime_guarantee: Inference and fine-tuning never deserialize the source Lightning pickle and never import pyannote.audio, Asteroid, Brouhaha, NumPy, einops, or Lightning.

inference: full synthetic PyanNet powerset graph against the pinned pyannote reference with converted segmentation-3.0 weights
deterministic chunking, powerset conversion, repeated-final-chunk handling, and Hamming overlap-add
VAD hysteresis and Brouhaha SNR/C50 frame metadata
training: Brouhaha VAD binary cross-entropy, speech-masked SNR MSE, and C50 MSE
all-silence Brouhaha batches with differentiable zero SNR loss
full backward through every native graph variant
limitations: No corpus-level VAD, diarization, SNR, or C50 benchmark was run, so no accuracy improvement over the published models is claimed.

The gated Hugging Face Brouhaha checkpoint could not be downloaded by the verifier account. Real-checkpoint verification used the pinned MIT-licensed GitHub checkpoint with the recorded SHA-256 instead.
CI runs numerical graph, checkpoint conversion, inference, training, export, and reload tests on shape-reduced configurations; published tensor inventories are validated separately.
